Giorgio @chiellini won nine consecutive Serie A titles while studying for a degree in economics and later an MBA.For him, education wasn’t preparation for retirement… It made him a better footballer.Studying gave Giorgio something away from the pressure of Juventus, kept his mind sharp and helped him process the split-second decisions required at the highest level.One week summed it up perfectly.He graduated from university in the same week Juventus played Barcelona twice in the Champions League quarter-finals. Giorgio scored in the first leg as Juventus went on to knock them out.Today he is back at Juventus as Chief Club Affairs Officer, working across the league, federation, UEFA and FIFA,
